examples.title: Example-1
examples.yaml:
apic:
  tenants:
    - name: ABC
      policies:
        igmp_snooping_policies:
          - name: IGMP-SNOOP1
            fast_leave: true
            querier: true
examples.explanation: This is a single example of an IGMP Sooping Policy where the IGMP Sooping Policy `IGMP-SNOOP1` is configured under tenant `ABC`. This sample illustrates a configuration where IGMP Fast Leave and Querier are `enabled`.

examples.title: Example-2
examples.yaml:
apic:
  tenants:
    - name: ABC
      policies:
        igmp_snooping_policies:
          - name: IGMP_Snooping_Disabled
            admin_state: false
examples.explanation: This is a single example of an IGMP Sooping Policy where the IGMP Sooping Policy IGMP_Snooping_Disabled is configured under tenant `ABC`. This sample illustrates a configuration where IGMP Snooping is `disabled`.
